purpose: Rate-futures quote and complete realized settlement calculations
admission: Instantiate the ready-pack schema checked by reconciliation/comparison.py. Nulls below are missing evidence; this template cannot be run or certified.

terms.required: All contractual economic terms, currency/notional/sign, independent schedules and settlement/entitlement rules. Do not approximate missing terms.

required_artifacts: upstream immutable source/archive hash and license/attribution bytes
comparator binary hash, compiler, OS/architecture and full dependency/submodule versions
exact CLI/build arguments and environment, execution receipt
full original economic inputs, curve/fixing/quote/calendar artifacts with effective and available times
original comparator outputs and explicit unit/sign/bump mapping
second independent source or analytic invariant for disagreements
normalization: ORE NPV CSV or explicitly exported ISDA grid CSV may be normalized with declared columns/currencies. This step does not price or qualify the reference.
